rules.action: Toggles the panel from the trigger (aria-expanded flips). Non-modal: focus stays on the trigger. Modal: focus moves into the panel.
Non-modal: from the trigger, moves into the open panel (it is next in DOM order); from the last element in the panel, continues into the page. Modal: from the last element wraps to the first.
Closes and returns focus to the trigger (from inside the panel; a persistent sidebar ignores it).
Non-modal: from the first element in the panel, returns to the trigger and leaves the panel open. Modal: wraps to the last element.
